subtopics.title: 2026 Dirac Medal winners
subtopics.summary: Indian physicist Deepak Dhar won the 2026 Dirac Medal alongside three other physicists, including Bernard Derrida and Haim Sompolinsky. The recognition was for pioneering work in statistical mechanics. This subtopic covers who won and the field of their work.

quizzes.title: Dirac Medal: award check
quizzes.passage: The Dirac Medal is an annual award that honours the legacy of the renowned physicist Paul Dirac. Dirac is remembered as one of the founders of modern quantum mechanics, and the medal carries his name in recognition of his influence on the subject. In 2026, the medal was awarded to the physicist Deepak Dhar, who shared the honour with three other physicists. The recognition was given for pioneering work in statistical mechanics, the field in which their research lies. Each recipient of the award receives a medal, which marks the honour in a tangible form. The award is given every year, and the 2026 medal is the latest of these presentations. Readers preparing for competitive examinations should keep the winners, the field of the work and the namesake of the award together while revising. Knowing the namesake links the medal to the history of quantum mechanics, and knowing the field helps in identifying the 2026 work. This item appears in the AILET Corner of the August 2026 current affairs section. A short written summary, with each detail on its own line, makes these facts easier to recall before an examination. Each of the details above is part of the same award, so revising them together helps in keeping the item clear in memory.
